concept.title: Link published pages to their DITA sources
concept.shortdesc: Add Edit this page and View source actions to topic pages, with links to Git hosting or the AEM Guides DAM.

conbody.p: Set zensical.source.links to git or aem to add page actions. The plug-in overrides Zensical's partials/actions.html theme partial so each page can use its own source URLs from front matter.

When the input map sets chunk="to-content", child topics are included in a combined output document. Each child topic with its own DITA source file gets an Edit link beside its heading. The page-level Edit this page and View source actions continue to target the page's root topic.

section.title: Git links
section.p: For a Git repository, the plug-in detects the repository, branch, and hosting service from the checkout. SSH remotes are converted to HTTPS. Detached checkouts, including many CI builds, use the commit instead of a branch name.

section.title: AEM Guides links
section.p: Set the DAM URL root to the location that corresponds to the source topic paths. The plug-in appends each topic's path to that root by default. Use {path} in a URL template when the path belongs elsewhere in the URL.
For both actions in AEM, set zensical.aem.view-url to a separate root if the view action uses a different URL. The plug-in does not assume an editor URL because Adobe does not document one as stable.

section.title: Map staged topic files to their source paths
section.p: A staged build may read copied topic files whose paths do not identify their original locations. For example, an AEM Guides mirror can stage topics in one flat directory with GUID filenames. Set zensical.source.path-map to a tab-separated file that maps each staged filename to a path under the configured source root:

The first column is the filename read by the build; the second is its path under the Git or DAM root. Further columns are ignored. Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped. Unmapped topics fall back to their path under zensical.source.root. Topics outside that root receive no buttons and are listed in a warning. The generated home page also has no source actions because it has no DITA source.

section.title: Source-link parameters

row.entry: Show the edit, view, or both actions.
Checkout root for Git; map folder for AEM
Local folder that corresponds to the repository root or DAM URL root.
Tab-separated mapping from staged filenames to paths under the source root.
Required DAM URL root when source links use AEM.
DAM URL root used by the view action.
Branch used to build source links; detached checkouts link to the commit.
URL style: github, gitlab, bitbucket, gitea, or azure.
Full URL template for edit, and view unless the view template is set.
Full URL template for the view action.

section.p: URL templates accept {path} (URL-encoded), {raw_path}, {repo}, {branch}, and {topic_id}. Unsafe characters in configured URLs are percent-encoded. Git view links open the hosting service's file view. Azure Repos has no direct edit URL, so both actions open the file view.

The plug-in enables Zensical's content.action.edit and content.action.view features to match the configured actions. It writes the partial to out/overrides/partials/actions.html and sets custom_dir when possible. If the custom directory points outside the output folder, copy the partial from resources/overrides/partials/actions.html.
